title: The prescribed ordinary quotient model is a reduction presentation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme Y and a flat-term K-flat complex P on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme, def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Use the precise quotient complex and fixed coherent reduction and ordinary evaluation isomorphisms of [def-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization-data, def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core]. These data satisfy CoefficientReductionPresentation [def-pur-coefficient-reduction-presentation]: at every natural-number level n (positive exponent n+1), the localization of the ordinary evaluation isomorphism composed with the evaluated coherent reduction comparison equals the finite K-flat reduction comparison composed with the calculus evaluation map; every actual quotient transition commutes with the prescribed ordinary evaluation isomorphisms. No replacement of P or its quotient system is allowed.

source.place: Integral level and reduction compatibility; the single-input presentation step of lem-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-normalization. Stacks 0941 and 06YY; normalization equations of pullbackTensorReductionModel_existsUnique and pullbackTensorReductionEvaluation_existsUnique.

proof.text: First identify the fixed ordinary evaluation isomorphism with the composite of the ordinary factorization tensor comparison and the unique comparison of left adjoints. Apply the ordinary factorization transpose, its limit-projection formula and homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. The resulting unit equation is exactly the defining predicate of pullbackTensorReductionEvaluation_existsUnique, so its uniqueness gives equality of the isomorphisms.

Extend the defining K-injective normalization of coefficientConstantTowerProjection to every tower complex. Choose a K-injective quasi-isomorphism, use naturality of the right-derived unit and the projection, and cancel its localized exact evaluation. The standard exact-functor composition and natural-isomorphism localization formulas then express pullbackTensorLimitUnit followed by the finite projection as the localized degreewise ordinary limit projection.

Apply the finite scalar-extension Hom equivalence to the desired comparison square and cancel the exact restriction factor. The calculus unit_projection and projection naturality identify the coherent side with the transpose of the fixed reduction model followed by the finite projection. Insert pullbackTensorReductionModel_existsUnique and the preceding total-limit projection formula. In every degree, pullbackTensorReductionEvaluation_existsUnique cancels its hom against its inverse, leaving the localized ordinary finite unit. The normalized derived scalar-extension adjunction gives precisely the same unit after coefficientFiniteReductionModel; convert its homotopy localization factors to the cochain factors. This proves the finite comparison equation.

Transport the ordinary factorization tensor_transition identity across the unique ordinary left-adjoint comparison. Naturality of coefficientSequenceTransition moves its inverse comparison through the transition; functoriality then gives the transition equation for the fixed evaluation inverses. Apply it to each degree of the input complex and use cochain-map extensionality. Combine this with the finite comparison equation to obtain CoefficientReductionPresentation. Neither argument excludes zero complexes, exponent one or identity transitions.

proof_origin.place: M1: explicit adjunction-unit and derived-projection calculation, using the ordinary factorization tensor_transition; the prescribed ordinary quotient and all fixed comparisons are retained. Stacks 0941, 06YY and the recorded finite derived-adjunction normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem completedQuotientReductionPresentation
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) :
    CoefficientReductionPresentation l E Y
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction
      P.obj P.property.1 (quotient l E P.obj)
      ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E Y).app P)
      (fun n ↦ ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E Y n).app P.obj).symm)
